verdict.rationale: An experimentation and feature-flag platform could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant that consumes external MCP servers, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents Statsig acting as an MCP server: its MCP server exposes Statsig data to tools like Cursor and Claude Code, and a Docs MCP server serves its documentation. That is the server role and earns no credit for the client-side ability to plug other MCP servers in, which has no evidence.
